## Summary

Which Open HVAC module changes, and why?

## Checklist

- [ ] I used a feature branch and did not edit download branches.
- [ ] No credentials, customer data or private device identifiers are committed.
- [ ] I updated the module catalog and documentation if distribution changed.
- [ ] Read-only operation and hardware interlocks are preserved.
- [ ] I documented exact supported hardware/firmware and physical validation.
- [ ] Local tests and package ZIP checks pass (or limitations are described).

## Tests and hardware

Include relevant test output and clearly distinguish simulator tests
from validation on physical equipment.

## Rollback

Describe how to revert the change without affecting working HVAC systems.
